Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 37 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Kunal: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal dances to the music.]

Vinod (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Kunal hugs Mother tightly.]

Hema: "What happened?"

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Vinod: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Kunal scratches his head.]

Vinod: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal thinks for a moment.]

Kunal (softly): "One more time!"

[Kunal shouts angrily.]

Kunal: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal takes the bag from Mother.]

Kunal (softly): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal rides his bicycle down the road.]

Hema: "One more time!"

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Vinod: "Let's see."

[Kunal hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Hema: "Vinod, look over here."

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal sips hot tea from a cup.]

Kunal (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Kunal watches cartoons on TV.]

Hema (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Kunal knocks on the door.]

Kunal (gently): "What next?"

[Kunal opens the door and goes out.]

Vinod: "I really enjoyed today."
